test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Bestial
solution:
The correct answer is **Brutish**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **most appropriate** synonym for the given word '**Bestial**' is '**Brutish**'.
 
• The meaning of the word '**Bestial**' is '**savagely cruel and depraved**'. (वहशी, पाशविक) 
 
• The meaning of the word '**Brutish**' is '**cruel and unpleasant**'. (पाशविक, पशु के समान)
 
• Hence, the most appropriate synonym is '**Brutish**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the other options.
 
 
• **Greedy**: wanting more food, money, power, etc. than you really need. (लालची)
 
• **High-minded**: having strong moral principles. (उच्च आदर्शों वाला)
 
• **Noble**: belonging to the highest social class, honest; full of courage, and care for others. (उदार)
 
 

52:T93b,

ਸਹੀ ਉੱਤਰ **Brutish (ਕਠੋਰ)** ਹੈ।
